title: Defiant Sarkozy says prison life is ‘very hard’ as he seeks release from jail – Europe live
summary: Former president is seeking to be released pending his appeal against a five-year sentence for criminal conspiracy In his closing arguments, reported by BFM TV , Sarkozy is reported to have lamented that his life in prison was “hard, very hard,” as he once again insisted he was innocent. “I will never confess to something I didn’t do,” he said, adding he continues his fight “for the truth to prevail.” Continue reading...
